implementation_strategy: Paired execution on 50 deterministic, synthetic confirmatory tasks (each task run under baseline and guarded pipelines). Baseline: single hosted-model call per task to produce vendor-specific CLI config (direct_configuration_generation_v1). Guarded: single hosted-model call per task where the verifier (CPU-executable deterministic verifier) validates and, if failing, provides assertions inserted back to the model for a single repair attempt encoded within the single guarded call contract (adapter enforces 2 calls-per-task budget collapsed into adapter's two-call accounting). All verifier scoring and pass/fail labels computed by the deterministic verifier (autonomous scoring). Immutable logging of prompts, responses, verifier assertions, timestamps, seeds, and SHA-256 hashes stored in repository. Timeouts: per-model-call = provider default or 120s (whichever smaller); per-task wall-time = 5 minutes. No human scientific labour or manual adjudication.
public_resources: Synthetic Intent→Configuration Task Suite (this study; generated with fixed RNG seed)
Deterministic CPU-executable verifier and reachability simulator (repository artifact)
Immutable execution logs and hashes (to be published alongside paper)
task_manifest_strategy: Generate 50 confirmatory tasks using the internal topology generator with a fixed RNG seed. Use 10 synthetic topologies (5 tasks each) and distribute vendor-CLI families (Cisco IOS, Juniper Junos, Arista EOS) across tasks where feasible. All task generation code, seeds, and resulting task files versioned and hashed prior to execution.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Baseline uses direct_configuration_generation_v1 prompt template. Guarded uses generate_validate_repair_v1: model input includes original intent plus deterministic verifier failure assertions. Vendor templating and syntax-normalization applied deterministically. Repair budget limited to the adapter-enforced single additional model interaction encoded in guarded pipeline accounting (adapter call budget=2 per task).
execution_batches: batch-1: tasks 1-50 (paired runs: baseline + guarded per task, executed sequentially to preserve pairing and deterministic logs)
randomisation_plan: No random permutation at execution time: task order fixed by deterministic seed. Pairing preserved by running both pipelines for each task consecutively. Any sampling replacements deterministic using the same RNG stream.
caching_plan: Cache all model responses, verifier outputs, and normalized configs to avoid repeated provider calls; cached artifacts immutable-hashed. Do not rely on local GPU; all calls via hosted API.
failure_recovery_plan: Adapter-enforced maximum_attempts_per_call=1: on any model-call or verifier runtime failure mark the task attempt as technical failure, record error type and hash, and deterministically resample a replacement task from the pre-specified generator (maintain N=50). No human intervention or manual retries permitted.
result_schema: Per-task paired episode record: task_id, topology_id, vendor, intent, baseline_output, guarded_output, verifier_assertions_pre_repair, verifier_assertions_post_repair, final_verifier_pass (baseline, guarded), model_call_count (baseline, guarded), wall_time_seconds, hashes for prompts/outputs/verifier logs, flags (residual_uncertainty, contamination).
estimated_compute_notes: Estimated model calls = task_count * 2 = 50 * 2 = 100 calls. All verifier and simulator computation is CPU-executable within the provided environment. Total wall-clock execution expected <1 day including logging under hosted API latency assumptions and capability_manifest maximum_wall_clock_days=7.
